evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically during growth from ~3.05 to 3.38 Torr while Ar flow steady at 100 sccm
MFC stable at setpoint, so pressure rise is not a flow change
Temperature holds 750 °C at plausible heater power ~44%
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/leak cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (not installed) or a flow-off pressure/leak-up test to distinguish a downstream exhaust restriction from an air leak into the tube.
